chapter: Race and racism on the road
title: Living in Paris and leaving America over racism
summary: He was not going to return from France because of racism, as in his joking letters home.

blocks.x: True story, right honey? So and it became a big seller. So then one day I’m in New York, because I wasn’t going to come back, I was living in France then, in Paris. I wasn’t going to come back because I never will forget I used to write things to my mother and I used to say things like, I shouldn’t have said it but that’s the way I felt, because in those days, like if you say an ofay cat, that meant a Caucasian person. Ofay. So I’d put “U.S.A. Land of the Ofay.” And my mother would say, oh, they’ll put you in jail for that. Because I had had it, like with the racism that went on.
